name: Van Trinh Cave
kicker: A lit cave inside Mo Mountain
summary: Walk the lit chambers of a cave of nearly 3,500 square metres inside Mo Mountain. The gazetteer it quotes splits the cave into a daylight front and a deep rear that once needed a torch. A fee and a gate hour were not on that page.
dotReason: A show cave in Nho Quan, off the main boat
getThere: Inside núi Mõ, xã Thượng Hòa, huyện Nho Quan.
heroCaption: A lit column of flowstone inside Van Trinh
body: The 2017 tourism page puts the cave in the heart of núi Mõ, xã Thượng Hòa, huyện Nho Quan, and sizes it at nearly 3,500 square metres. The folk name of the mountain is pictorial. The literary name it gives is núi Thổ Tích. It quotes Đại Nam nhất thống chí: the mountain lies 32 dặm west of Gia Viễn district, the cave on the slope splits in two, the front opens to the light, and the rear is deep enough that you needed a torch and wide enough for a few hundred people.

What you walk now is the lit stone: columns, curtains, and a second chamber with the ceiling still in the lamp. The old gazetteer's torch is for the deep rear, not a rule for the lit front. A fee, a gate hour, and a minute from the station were not printed.

figures.caption: Another chamber, with the ceiling still in the lamp
figures.alt: Orange-lit stalactites and a rock mass inside Van Trinh Cave

gettingThere: The cave is in xã Thượng Hòa, huyện Nho Quan, inside núi Mõ. From Ga Ninh Bình or from Vân Long you need a road transfer. Minutes and kilometres were not on the tourism page.

legs.heading: From Ga Ninh Bình
legs.body: Ride to xã Thượng Hòa. The tourism page names the commune and the district. It does not print a minute.

legs.heading: From Gia Viễn
legs.body: The gazetteer line on the tourism page puts núi Thổ Tích 32 dặm west of the old Gia Viễn district seat. That is the historical measure, not a modern road minute.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: A fee was not on the 2017 tourism page or on the Tràng An ticket board opened 23 October 2026.
